title: Mathematics, Standard Nine — Grade 9 Mathematics (Tamil Nadu State Board)

source.title: Mathematics, Standard Nine
source.edition: First Edition 2018 (trimester, 3 term books); Revised Edition 2019 single volume, reprinted annually (latest circulating copy labelled 2025 edition)
source.publisher: Tamil Nadu Textbook and Educational Services Corporation (content: SCERT Tamil Nadu)
source.licence: Chapter and section titles as printed (facts); outcomes written by OpenPath in its own words; no textbook text is reproduced.

review.by: OpenPath curriculum inventory (research from official and secondary sources; not an educator review)
review.note: Built from content/learning/syllabus/tn-g09.json. Each outcome was mapped to competencies by the inventory; outcomes were placed in sections by shared title words. Sources: https://cdn1.byjus.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/TN-Board-Class-9-Maths-Textbook-English.pdf https://cdn1.byjus.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/TN-Board-Class-9-Maths-Term-1-Textbook.pdf https://cdn1.byjus.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Tamil-Nadu-State-Board-Textbooks_Samacheer-Kalvi-Books_Class-9th_Maths-chapter-8_-English-Medium.pdf https://www.brainkart.com/subject/Maths-9th-std_350/. Notes: Official sites could not be read: textbooksonline.tn.nic.in (robots disallowed for the fetch tool; shell has no internet), tnschools.gov.in/scert e-books page (JavaScript-rendered, no content returned), textbookcorp.tn.gov.in price-list PDF (robots disallowed), dge.tn.gov.in (no syllabus/blueprint notices visible). Textbook content was therefore read from copies of the official TNTBESC/SCERT PDF hosted on cdn1.byjus.com; the front matter (Government of Tamil Nadu, SCERT copyright) identifies it as the official book. Chapters are marked verified:true on that basis. Term structure: the 2018 First Edition was printed in trimester pattern (Term I: Set Language, Real Numbers, Algebra, Geometry, Coordinate Geometry; Term II: Set Language, Real Numbers, Algebra, Geometry, Statistics; Term III: Algebra, Coordinate Geometry, Trigonometry, Mensuration, Probability). The 2019 Revised Edition is a single volume with nine chapters, and this file follows it (terms:null, term:null on all chapters). TNTBESC 2026-27 notices list term-wise books only for Std 1-7, which supports single-volume Std 9; not confirmed by an explicit Std 9 notice. outcomes.text: Locate rational numbers on the number line and find rational numbers between two given rationals.

mapping.why: Mapped by the curriculum inventory (marked automatically; expression, numeric, multiple-choice).

mapping.why: Mapped by the curriculum inventory (marked automatically; numeric, expression, true-false).

outcomes.text: Expand and apply identities for (a+b+c)^2, products of three binomials, and cubes of binomials, and use them to evaluate or factorise.

outcomes.text: Divide a polynomial by another using long division and synthetic division, expressing the result with the division algorithm.

mapping.why: Mapped by the curriculum inventory (marked automatically; expression).

mapping.why: Mapped by the curriculum inventory (marked automatically; expression).
